title: Greenpill Nigeria Water Cup Mapping
dek: In June and July 2025, Greenpill Nigeria and Atlantisp2p surveyed water access and sanitation in 15 communities across Anambra, Enugu and Imo States.
excerpt: Water Cup's mapping stage gathered grassroots data on drinking water, taps, wastewater and toilets, and contributors received impact certificates.
body:
Water Cup is an environmental and public health initiative by Greenpill Nigeria with Atlantisp2p, working toward safe, clean and accessible water in Nigeria. It has three stages: mapping, implementing and maintaining. Greenpill Nigeria shared results from the first stage on the Regen Coordination Hub on July 17, 2025.

## Mapping water access

Run through a Greenpill dNFT campaign, the mapping stage assessed water access, use and sanitation in Southeastern Nigeria around four themes: drinking water quality, tap water access, wastewater disposal and sanitation facilities. Between June and July 2025, research teams visited 15 localities, each team covering three:

- Anambra State: Ihite, Ezira, Umunze, Ufuma, Amansea, Enugwu-Ukwu, Amaokpala, Ifite-Oko and Ezi-Oko
- Enugu State: Abakpa, Trans-Ekulu and Emene
- Imo State: Isu, Ikeduru and Mbaise

The teams interviewed more than 75 residents, inspected sites and documented what they saw. The chapter reported widespread reliance on untreated water, inconsistent tap supply and low pressure, clogged drainage, and poorly maintained toilets, especially in low-income and rural communities.

## Recognizing contributors

By July 2025, the field research and report were complete, and contributors could claim $250 in USDGlo along with impact certificates. A Water Cup Mapping hypercert is published on Celo. The next step, an implementation stage, was listed for funding on Impact Landscapes.

Greenpill Nigeria also showcased Water Cup at its Ethereum at 10 meetup in Awka on July 30, 2025.
